'''Fillata''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Prael/Legends|Prael]] in the [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Japrael sector/Legends|Japrael sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]]<ref name="Region" /> of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Fillata had three [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and a [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]], except [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
